why: Restores the player-only gate this had as a refusal arm, where it was correct: an enemy's REFUSAL would have reported the enemy's ammunition state to the player. That reason does not survive #536 -- firing is already visible, the shell is right there -- and the gate now produces enemy guns that fire clean while the player's smokes. A stale guard whose original justification has been removed is exactly the kind of thing a port forward reintroduces, and barrel-recoil-player-only records the identical mistake one file over.
killedBy: muzzle smoke (issue #536, parent #356) smokes EVERY living tank, enemies included, and never a dead one
